claims.claim: You can apply for Pension Age Winter Heating Payment online.
claims.note: The online eligibility checker is explicitly outside the application process, and no online application route is given.

claims.claim: You can apply for Pension Age Winter Heating Payment by phone.
claims.quote: We can consider late applications if you have a good reason for missing the deadline. If this is the case, contact Social Security Scotland.
claims.note: The source gives a phone contact route for possible late applications but does not expressly say applications can be made by phone.

claims.claim: Applicants must provide proof of age.
claims.note: The page states an age-based eligibility condition but does not request documentary proof of age.

claims.claim: Applicants must provide proof of Scottish residency.
claims.note: The page states a Scottish-residence condition but does not request documentary proof of residence.
